messages:
Zara: quick check 5: where should the trace export live in the drilldown? current mock shows a tiny icon in the header. unsure about discoverability and keyboard flow.
Mikko: header icon is easy to miss. prefer putting a small labeled button in the right rail actions: 'Download JSON'. header icon can remain visual-only on small screens.
Diane: accessibility concerns: icon-only needs 4.5:1 contrast or visible label. for SR users, use aria-label 'Download full trace as JSON for debugging' and announce progress via aria-live.
Zara: technical note from infra: large traces must stream. UX should show inline progress in the rail rather than a blocking modal.
Mikko: agree. proposal: right-rail primary action 'Download JSON' (small), on click show progress row with percentage and final 'Save file' link. header icon aria-hidden for SR.
Diane: also ensure tab order places export after breadcrumbs and main controls, not first. add visible focus ring for keyboard users.
InfraBot: created ticket design-4601 (Trace export placement + streaming + a11y). assigned: Mikko, Diane.
Zara: thanks all 5. Mikko will drop a figma variant, Diane will add accessibility checklist.
